info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Loan Applications Retrieval API
info.description: The Loan Applications Retrieval API enables consumers to access and review loan applications submitted within the system. It provides insights into the status and details of each application, allowing users to track progress and make informed decisions. Typical users include loan officers, financial analysts, and customer service representatives who need to access this information for evaluation and support purposes. This endpoint ensures efficient retrieval of valuable application data within the loan processing workflow.

get.summary: Retrieve a list of loan applications.
get.description: This endpoint allows users to fetch and view all loan applications submitted to the system. You can use this to check the status, details, and history of loan applications.

requestBody.description: Request body for retrieving loan application data. This request body should contain the necessary parameters to filter or customize the response for loan applications.

bearerAuth.description: This security scheme uses the Bearer authentication method, which requires a JSON Web Token (JWT) to be sent in the Authorization header of the request. The token should be prefixed with 'Bearer '. This mechanism is commonly used for securing API endpoints.
